description: Root cause + confidence, grounded via call graph and symbol verification; submits through submit_diagnosis, which rejects ungrounded diagnoses.

rules.name: submitted_via_tool
rules.why: a conclusion written as prose instead of submitted was a real bug (PR #224); runs without a submission passed 0% of the time (92 recorded DeepSeek trials)

rules.name: read_before_first_submit
rules.why: drift signal: does the agent read code before its first submission? (did not predict correctness on recorded runs, so it is monitored, not gated)
